name: 企查查·法律数据
description: Search and verify Chinese statutes and judicial cases through natural language. Covers full in-force laws at both statute and article level with validity tagging, a massive body of judgment documents plus 25,000+ authoritative cases, and citation verification that eliminates fabricated statutes and case numbers in AI-generated legal content.
description_zh: 检索与核验中国法律法规和司法案例。覆盖全量现行法律、行政法规、司法解释——法规级到法条级逐字正文，标注时效性与效力级别；海量裁判文书及 2.5 万+ 权威案例（最高法/最高检指导性案例、公报案例、典型案例）；并对文本中的法条与案号引用逐条回库核验、标注时效、生成可溯源超链。用自然语言完成法条依据查找、类案检索、原文调取与法律引用核验，从源头消除法条与案号幻觉。
description_en: QCC Legal is a Chinese legal-data connector for searching, researching, and verifying statutes and judicial cases. On the regulation side it covers the full body of in-force Chinese law — laws, administrative regulations, departmental rules, judicial interpretations, and local regulations — at both the whole-regulation and individual-article level, returning verbatim text tagged with validity status (in force / amended / repealed), legal hierarchy, and promulgating authority, with common-name normalization (e.g. the Civil Code, the Personal Information Protection Law). On the case side it covers a massive corpus of ordinary judgment documents plus 25,000+ authoritative cases — Supreme People's Court and Supreme People's Procuratorate guiding cases, gazette cases, typical cases, and reference cases — filterable by cause of action, court, instance, judgment date, and party. It further verifies legal citations: given any text it detects every statute and case-number reference, checks each against the database, flags validity status, returns the authoritative source and verbatim text, and generates traceable hyperlinks — eliminating fabricated statutes and case numbers in AI-generated legal content. Use natural language to find statutory grounds, run legal research and analysis, retrieve similar cases, pull verbatim originals, and verify citations before delivery.
examples_zh: 员工拒绝调岗被解除劳动合同，有哪些法律依据？请给出法条原文并确认是否现行有效
找几个卖方违约的买卖合同纠纷判决作类案参考
有没有关于个人信息保护的最高法指导性案例？
对方逾期交货三个月，我方能否解除合同并主张违约金？帮我研判一下
核验这段话的引用：「依据《劳动合同法》第二十三条、第二十四条和《民法典》第五百八十五条，竞业限制违约金约定过高的可以请求适当减少」——法条是否真实、是否现行有效，附上溯源链接
examples_en: An employee was dismissed for refusing job reassignment — what are the legal grounds? Give the verbatim statute text and confirm it is currently in force.
Find a few sales-contract dispute judgments where the seller breached, as similar-case references.
Are there any Supreme People's Court guiding cases on personal information protection?
The other party delayed delivery by three months — can we terminate the contract and claim liquidated damages? Give me an assessment.

Verify the citations in this passage: "Under Articles 23 and 24 of the Labor Contract Law and Article 585 of the Civil Code, an excessive non-compete penalty may be reduced upon request." Are these provisions real and currently in force? Include source links.
